strings.callbackwarning:
1. Get a Flickr API Key and Secret from Flickr for this Moodle site.
  2. Enter those details here, then click Save and then Settings to come back to this page. You will see that Moodle has generated a callback URL for you.
  3. Edit your Flickr key details again and set the callback URL.
